song: Lucy in the Sky with Diamonds
album: Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band
story: The psychedelic centerpiece of Pepper: a watery, rotating, dreamlike swirl over a clean Fender-style base. We approximate the rotating-speaker effect with the Leslie pedal (modulated delay pitch vibrato + amplitude tremolo + light stereo spread) on top of the FENDER_BLACKFACE voicing, with reverb pushed wetter than the other presets for that underwater feel. Listen for the slow pitch wobble and stereo width rather than any pick-attack transient.
